test_title: SSC GD Constable (2022) Official Paper (Held On : 27 Jan 2023 Shift 4)
subject: general
question: Under which scheme, 5 Crore LPG (Liquified Petroleum Gas) connections were provided to Below Poverty Line (BPL) families?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **LPG, or Liquified Petroleum Gas,** is a **clean-burning fuel **that is used for **cooking, heating, and lighting **in households and industries.
 
• The **Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana** is a government scheme launched in **2016 **that aims to provide** clean cooking fuel **to women from below poverty line households.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Sansad Adarsh Gram Yojana:** This is a** rural development scheme** launched in **2014** that aims to develop model villages in each **constituency of India.**
 
• **Skill India Mission:** This is a government initiative launched in **2015** that aims to train and provide **employment opportunities** to the youth of India.
 
• **Beti Bachao Beti Padhao: **This is a campaign launched in** 2015** that aims to promote the **education and welfare** of girls in India.
